parameters.name: AutoProvisioningGroupId
parameters.description: The IDs of auto-provisioning groups. You can specify up to 20 auto-provisioning group IDs.

parameters.name: AutoProvisioningGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the auto provisioning group.

parameters.name: AutoProvisioningGroupStatus
parameters.description: The list of statuses of auto-provisioning groups.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the paging query to return.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page in the paging query. Settings:

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the auto-provisioning group resides.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the auto-provisioning group belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags attached to the auto-provisioning group.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the auto-provisioning group.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the auto-provisioning group.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://.
